description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) command 'connect' for an application called OpenClaw on macOS. It handles parsing command-line arguments, establishing a WebSocket connection to a gateway, executing health checks, and printing results in either human-readable or JSON format. The file contains options parsing, output data structures, connection logic, and utility functions related to establishing and managing a gateway connection.

classes.name: ConnectOptions
classes.description: A data structure representing command-line options for connecting, with a static method to parse arguments.

classes.name: ConnectOutput
classes.description: A data structure for formatting output of the connect operation, compatible with JSON encoding.

classes.name: SnapshotStore
classes.description: An actor class that holds a mutable snapshot of type HelloOk, allowing concurrent access.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A structure representing the URL, token, password, and mode of a gateway endpoint (implied, based on context).

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure holding gateway-related settings, not fully detailed in the snippet.

classes.name: GatewayChannelActor
classes.description: An actor responsible for managing WebSocket connection, requests, and push handling (assumed from context).

classes.name: ProtoAnyCodable
classes.description: A type for decoding arbitrary protocol buffer messages, as used for health info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into ConnectOptions.

methods.name: runConnect
methods.description: Main async function executing the connect command, handling connection setup, health check, and output formatting.

methods.name: printConnectOutput
methods.description: Outputs the result either as formatted text or JSON.

methods.name: resolveGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves the gateway endpoint based on options and configuration.
